indicators.label: Total resident population
indicators.description: Municipality total resident population represented in census table T-06.
indicators.method: Printed municipality total, 2021 census book table T-06.
indicators.quality_notes: The 2021 total resident population (1,836,713) includes 132,260 persons whose data, including religion, were taken from administrative sources; that component is rendered as its own published category, never repaired or redistributed.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the municipality population reporting affiliation with a named religion (Orthodox, Muslim/Islam, Catholic, Christian, Protestant, Evangelical, Evangelical Methodist, Jehovah's Witnesses, or Other).
indicators.method: 100 * (sum of the nine affiliation categories) / total resident population.
indicators.quality_notes: Thirteen verbatim census categories are preserved on the per-municipality quality flag. Percentages use each municipality's printed total resident population. The Undeclared, Unknown, and administratively-sourced lines stay in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the census Non-believer (atheist) line (Не е верник (атеист)).
indicators.method: 100 * (Non-believer (atheist) line) / total resident population. Undeclared, Unknown, and administratively-sourced persons are not part of this slot.
indicators.quality_notes: The Non-believer (atheist) national share is small (0.48%); the administratively-sourced residual (7.20%) is disclosed and never folded into the no-religion slot. Percentages use each municipality's printed total resident population. The Undeclared, Unknown, and administratively-sourced lines stay in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.
